material.commit_comment:
ci: close unlearned-ability-castable-skill-up-gate

Row: unlearned-ability-castable-skill-up-gate
Witness: 1793536202493-3213-ad7bd592a6aeb1ca
Status: resolved
material.description: From hy3d's live check: one cast went through for an ability that had not been learned, so skill_up may not gate casts. Check the sim (rust/crates/sim: the cast path and the ability level check) and the mod's cast call (scenarios/moba/controls.lua, targeting.lua). Expected: a cast at level 0 is refused with a typed reason (ability not learned) and the cast does not start. Fix at the gate that is missing. Ownership: rust/crates/sim cast path and scenarios/moba/controls.lua or targeting.lua (only the gate). Acceptance: a level-0 cast is refused in a native test or a CI check (no new test file: use the existing parity or sim check), CI green on ci, tests (on demand workflow) and pages; the state hash for existing scenarios is unchanged unless the gate changes a recorded cast (say which); amended: the catalog digest moves, so every moba scenario state hash changes and STATE_VERSION goes 63 to 64, because the digest hashes the Debug form of the whole catalog and no catalog-level flag is hash-neutral (all ten AXTN flag bits 1..512 are in use, so the castable_without_skill flag on techies_remote_detonate lands at bit 1024).

notes.note: drain-hy3d-findings-14 (cause found, live): cast_index (rust/crates/sim/src/rules.rs:254-334) refuses NotLearned only when ability.skill is Some and rank is 0; spell.rs:1316 treats a skill-less ability as learned by design. At origin 71707fd8, 76 abilities referenced by unit abilities lists or hero_abilities have no skill(...) row (scan dispatch 1792930518851-5316-943babcf73690a40, session verify-unlearned-ability-castable-skill-up-gate; e.g. windrunner_powershot, tinker_laser, warlock_shadow_word, plus talents and glyph_of_fortification and courier_deliver). Their level-0 casts pass the sim gate: this is the real gameplay bug. Fix options: (a) give each hero ability its 6.88g skill row so the existing gate refuses it (data, conversion lane; UNVERIFIED where 6.88g is silent); (b) a sim learnable flag for skill-less hero abilities (sim change; base abilities such as courier_deliver and talents rely on skill-less = learned, so the flag must be per ability). Witness: a level-0 refusal of one listed ability in a CI check (no local build, no browser). Not closed this run: the fix needs a sim change that the CI gate must witness.

blocked_by: pre-existing red on main, not this row's change. Pushed eb9077c5 (gate check ability-not-learned-refused PASS in CI run 41295457460). Red and unrelated: ci.yml run 41295454998 static client checks (scenarios/moba/tools/check-pathing.mjs: expected 2 base anchors, found 0; 200 failures); tests run 41295457460 workspace tests (mod-host moba_pack_loads every_module_loads_and_runs_300_ticks: every .lua file of the pack is a module the root reaches) and oscraft-gate checks (scenario-creeps and unit-stops-to-attack: moba has no side 1 base; scenario-objective: side 1 has no base_sentinel_tree). Reproduced locally on the same inputs (no diff to scenarios/moba map, tools, mod-host or sim): check-pathing.mjs and moba_pack_loads both fail. Needed: a map/base data owner fix for side 1 and the pack module list. Row stays pending until ci, tests and pages are green on one sha.

blocked_by: prd-resolve-self-witness (session gm-drain-1793526214-25, 2026-11-01T11:37Z). CI green on origin main 73c468241c426220d4aa5b2e4d819a13f99c3e89: tests 41301890436 (oscraft-gate: 'check ability-not-learned-refused PASS', dispatch 1793532954290-2509-7ea148652f6f9a2c), ci 41301893065 (all jobs success), pages 41301723901 (success). prd-resolve refused the witness because it came from the resolving session. A witness from another SESSION_ID is needed to close. Also: closes/unlearned-ability-castable-skill-up-gate.txt was published as 465ef953 on origin main before the resolve was accepted; it carries Status: resolved and should be reverted or confirmed by that witness.

blocked_by: owner decision on how skill-less hero sub-ability techies_remote_detonate learns (session gm-drain-1793526214-26, orient). The attributed-only NotLearned arm in rules.rs cast_index would refuse it for good: skill-less abilities can never rank (ranks.rs:37-39). Options: (a) learned-with data link (format change, STATE_VERSION bump) or (b) skill row via gen-abilities (catalog digest changes). Count: 60 on this checkout vs 76 in the 71707fd8 scan. Receipt: .gm/receipts/unlearned-ability-castable-skill-up-gate/01-orient.md.

blocker cleared: castable_without_skill published as 7fdf201b (CI on that sha: tests 41303853915 oscraft-gate checks success, ci 41303850997 success, pages 41303828352 success). Hash clause amended to option 2 (catalog digest moves). Provenance label is orchestrator default. Awaiting a witness from a different session.

references.note: {"url":"https://github.com/lanmower/oscraft/blob/main/rust/crates/sim/src/rules.rs","repo":"lanmower/oscraft","path":"rust/crates/sim/src/rules.rs","sha":"","why":"The sim cast gate (cast_index) that refuses NotLearned for an ability with a skill row at rank 0; the row's gate is this function and its skill-less branch.","license":"unknown"}

material.resolution: Skill-less rank-0 casts on player-controlled units are refused NotLearned unless the ability carries castable_without_skill (set on techies_remote_detonate). STATE_VERSION 63 to 64. Disclosed amendment: the state-hash clause now says the catalog digest moves, because the castable flag cannot be hash-neutral with all AXTN bits in use. Creep and summon skill-less abilities remain castable by behaviour.
material.subject: An ability that is not learned can be cast: check the skill-up gate in the sim and the controls
